note: Because's Scout intent registry. Every investigation runs under a signed contract scoped to these capabilities.

intents.description: Safe fallback. Not a why-question Because can investigate with data. Responds with guidance, routes to no tools.
Explain why a public company's financial metric (revenue, gross margin, operating margin, net income, R&D) changed in a given year, using SEC EDGAR filings and background context.
examples: Why did Intel's gross margin fall in 2024?
Why did Nvidia's revenue jump in fiscal 2024?
Why did Meta's net income drop in 2022?
Why did Apple's revenue decline in 2023?
What explains Tesla's lower operating margin in 2024?
Why was Microsoft's profit up in 2023?

intents.description: Explain why a macroeconomic indicator (inflation, unemployment) moved in a country and period, using official statistics (ONS, FRED) and background context.
examples: Why did UK inflation spike in 2022?
Why did US unemployment jump in 2020?
Why did US inflation rise so much in 2021?
What drove British CPI inflation up in 2023?
Why did unemployment in the UK rise in 2009?

intents.description: Explain what Because already believes about a topic and why: recall stored findings with their provenance (query, source row, when learned) and audit history.
examples: What do you already know about Intel's margins?
Why do you believe UK inflation was driven by energy?
What do you remember about Nvidia?
Show me your memory about inflation
